basis: Proposal informed by canonical evaluation design; not derived from independently labelled measurements
hard_requirements: No fabricated source, candidate identity or evidence location
No false supported Graph edge under independent human source review
No reversal of a central claim or confusion of experimental result with demonstrated guarantee
No score/readiness acceptance from unreviewed, failed or N/A items
Report all ten papers, missing outcomes, single-reviewer limitations and source/version mismatches
Preserve existing request, attempt, cost and timeout limits

proposed_thresholds.reason: At least two of three positions relevant on average; empty positions remain zero
Detect missing required predecessors before ranking; gold includes items outside retrieved candidates
Proposed should not underperform the stronger fixed-candidate baseline on the same labelled papers
Correct, partially_correct and incorrect remain separate; critical errors trigger a hard failure
Most displayed concepts should be required for the annotated transition
Cover the human-labelled 5-10-concept evaluation set; not a claim of complete concept recall

mandatory_additional_reports: Precision@5 and RequiredRecall@3/5 with attainable recall ceiling
NDCG@3 and per-paper paired baseline coverage
Graph relationship correctness, false-supported counts, abstentions and legitimate merges
Reasoning edge validity, major omissions and partial/incorrect fractions
Knowledge contextual accuracy and unnecessary explanations
Per-paper initial LLM cost including retries and held unknown costs; USD 1.00 target
Per-paper cold/cache latency, 5-minute soft-target hit counts and resource usage

aggregation.quality: macro over defined per-paper values with explicit denominator; no combined cross-feature quality score
aggregation.na: excluded from arithmetic only; retain counts/reasons and do not interpret a missing feature as passing
aggregation.paired_baseline: same papers with defined values for Proposed and both baselines; publish unmatched/NA cases
aggregation.insufficient_coverage: inconclusive until human decision; never silently pass a small reviewed subset
aggregation.required_recall_at_5: report without a fixed acceptance cutoff because attainable recall depends on required-set size
